skills.description: This skill should be used when a user uploads a soil photo and asks for soil health analysis, composition diagnosis, or soil restoration recommendations. Triggers include phrases like "看看这片土" "土壤诊断" "土质怎么样" "土壤修复" "生态土" "光合菌" plus an attached image.
